children: US crude inventories fell by 0.391 million barrels in the week ended September 4, 2026, less than market expectations for a 1.6 million-barrel drop.
Crude stocks at the Cushing, Oklahoma, delivery hub decreased by 0.684 million barrels in the week.
Refinery crude runs rose by 90,000 barrels per day.
Gasoline stocks increased by 1.269 million barrels, compared with forecasts for a 1.4 million-barrel draw.
Distillate stockpiles, which include diesel and heating oil, rose by 2.087 million barrels, versus expectations for a 0.7 million-barrel drop.
Net US crude imports rose by 1.12 million barrels per day.

title: S Crude Oil Inventories Fall Less than Expected
